text:
Ashley: Heads-up — we merged kernel v4.2.0 + new quant profile (q4_0_aggressive) to canary yesterday. Planning full pool rollout tonight 23:00 UTC. Quick check: who's taking ownership of post-deploy sanity and rollback readiness?

Ben: I'll own post-deploy for canary -> prod. I'll be on from 22:30-00:30 UTC. @Leah you'll be rollback lead?

Leah: Yep I can be rollback lead until 00:30. I've got the rollback playbook pinned in #eng-runtime and on the runbook page: https://internal/redwood/wiki/rollbacks.

Ben: Smoke checklist (short):
1) curl /health on sample routes
2) run perf-sample.py against representative models
3) confirm tail error rate < 0.5%
4) confirm mean p99 < 250ms for short seqs
5) KV cache warming sanity (prefix hit rate > 60%)

Sam: Quick commands to run locally / ops:
```
# health
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.test/v1/health

# quick perf smoke
python infra/tools/perf-sample.py --models llama-13b --batch 8 --seq 128
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by ci/deploys for 2027-06-01T23:00:00Z — target pool: pool-green — kernel:v4.2.0 + quant:q4_0_aggressive

Ashley: Reminder: rollback command (manual):
```
rctl rollback --pool pool-green --to-image kernel:v4.1.9
```
Confirm before running.

Priya: Also watch quant-specific metrics: query /metrics?q=quant_profile:q4_0_aggressive&window=5m — look for tokenization_errors and token_dropout. If tokenization_errors > 5/min flag immediately.

Ben: I'll post quick snapshots at 23:10, 23:30, and 00:00 UTC. If any threshold breached I'll call rollback.

Leah: I'll be on pager and in #eng-oncall. If I see p99 jump or error spike I'll DM Ben and then trigger rollback play.

Sam: Left a small staging-only tweak PR #4892 that reduces default batch from 12->8 to avoid mem pressure with the aggressive quant. Could merge post-smoke if we need headroom.

Ben: Noted. Ashley — do we want to extend canary window? Default is 30m.

Ashley: Let's set to 45m for this rollout because quant profile change is riskier. Auto-promote at 45m if no rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy started by ci/deploys at 23:00:05 UTC — kernel v4.2.0 -> pool-green (canary)

deploy-bot: initial healthchecks passed for 3/3 canary nodes at 23:03:58 UTC

Ben: Smoke run 1 (23:10): health OK, perf sample mean p99=230ms (seq128, batch8), error rate 0.12%, quant tokenization_errors=0, no OOMs. KV prefix hit 68%. Posting logs to the ops archive. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Looks good so far. Keeping an eye on token_dropout trends.

Ben: Will wait until 23:45 then trigger promote if still green.

Leah: Rollback criteria (my checklist): p99 increase >50ms sustained for 5m OR error_rate >0.8% OR tokenization_errors >5/min OR any OOMs. I have the rollback button and will coordinate with Ben.

Ashley: Thanks all. If anyone needs to abort earlier just ping @Leah and @Ben.

deploy-bot: deploy completed canary stage at 23:04:12 UTC — canary instances healthy

Ben: Smoke run 2 (23:30): still green, p99=238ms, error rate 0.15%, quant errors 0. No regressions in logs.

Sam: Merged PR #4892 to staging only — will hold for prod unless we see memory signals.

Priya: Promoting to full pool at 23:50 unless objections.

Leah: Ready to roll back if any of the thresholds hit. I'll open rollback channel and coordinate.

Ben: Promoting at 23:50 now. Will post final metrics at ~00:10.

deploy-bot: promotion to full pool scheduled at 23:50:00 UTC by ci/promote — target: all-green

Ben: Final check (00:10): all pools stable, cluster p99s within expected, error rates low. quant token stats nominal. No rollback. Marking rollout successful. :tada:

Ashley: Great job team — Ben owner, Leah rollback lead, Priya monitoring metrics. Closing thread after 00:30 UTC.

Leah: Copy. Will close after oncall handoff.
